gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-cypro-minoa: Expressive Underdog draws every curve at a constant width, horseshoe-open. Noto Sans Cypro Minoan, a sans-serif with terminals cut back to leave big gaps, can go a touch larger without crowding.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-inscription: Noto Sans Inscriptional Pahlavi keeps its small counters unclogged. Underdog's bent-straw lines and horseshoe c-shape give the heading real swagger, while this sans-serif body stays low in contrast and approachable.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-noto-sans-old-south-a: Noto Sans Old South Arabian ends its curves before they turn inward. Make Underdog small and its horseshoe curves lose their swagger; blow the body up and the sans loses its quiet.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-pt-sans: Underdog draws every stroke like cut ribbon of constant width, with a horseshoe-wide c-shape up top for good measure. PT Sans offers open arcs and a friendly, low-contrast build.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-red-hat-text: Loud, rounded swagger up top, as Underdog bends a horseshoe-open c with no weight shift. Red Hat Text, plain sans drawn with a technical pen's line weight, feels unclamped and friendly beside it.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-sansation: Wire-bent sign lettering from Underdog, constant in thickness, loud and horseshoe-open. Sansation, plain sans with no ink pooling where curves turn in, is the approachable low-contrast partner that heading needs.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-shippori-antique: Underdog never shifts weight along a curve, even in its horseshoe c. Shippori Antique, plain sans with a monoweight skeleton and open bowls, takes over the reading while the heading makes the noise.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-sn-pro: Underdog: commanding, horseshoe-open, with no brush-style swell anywhere. SN Pro, a sans-serif with open aperture curves throughout, keeps paragraphs moving smoothly and feels modern from first line to last.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-snippet: Wire-bent swagger runs through both fonts: Underdog's horseshoe c-shape and Snippet's crescent-wrench c, each one opened wide. That shared wire-bent, wide-mouthed look is the strongest draw in this pairing.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-special-gothic: Underdog builds its letters from rods rather than carved blades, with a horseshoe c-shape. Special Gothic, a rounded sans, stays open and inviting underneath, so the two read smoothly together.
